body.description: HubSpot Property definition from GET /crm/properties/2026-09/{objectType}/{propertyName}. The product only reads property definitions and never creates or edits them. Query parameters, all optional: archived (boolean, default false; true returns only archived properties), dataSensitivity (highly_sensitive, non_sensitive or sensitive; default non_sensitive), locale (string) and properties (string). Startup verification uses this surface to: resolve the contacts.lifecyclestage option labels configured in config/hubspot_mapping.yaml (for example First meeting booked, Qualified Lead, Sales Qualified Lead) to their internal option values, which are numeric strings for custom stages; confirm that the stage-entry property hs_v2_date_entered_{option value} exists; confirm that a property-mode MQL or QL binding names an existing date or datetime property; and confirm the optional HUBSPOT_GOOGLE_CAMPAIGN_PROPERTY and HUBSPOT_GOOGLE_TOUCH_DATE_PROPERTY contact properties. MQL and QL are bound independently: QL is never derived from MQL, a later current stage never stands in for an empty stage-entry date, and the default Marketing Qualified Lead stage counts as MQL only when the configuration names it. A label with no matching option, or a property that does not exist (a 404, handled by the connector outside this success contract), makes its metric unavailable, never zero. Fields follow the reference exactly: none is nullable, optional fields may be absent, and timestamps and user ids stay wire strings.

description.description: Help text shown for the property in HubSpot; may be an empty string.

fieldType.description: How the property appears in HubSpot, for example radio, select, date or text.

groupName.description: Name of the property group the property belongs to.

name.description: Internal property name used through the API, for example lifecyclestage or hs_v2_date_entered_{stage id}.

options.description: Valid options for enumerated properties; empty for other property types.

items.description: One option of an enumerated property, such as a contacts.lifecyclestage stage.

hidden.description: True when HubSpot hides the option from its UI.

label.description: Human-readable option label; configured MQL and QL stage labels are matched against it.

value.description: Internal option value used through the API. Custom lifecycle stages use numeric strings such as "1406943076", which are valid suffixes in hs_v2_date_entered_{value}.

displayOrder.description: Display position; -1 places the option after positive values, so no positivity is assumed.

type.description: Property data type, for example enumeration, datetime, date, string, number or bool. Not constrained to an enum, matching the reference.

archivedAt.description: When the property was archived, as an ISO 8601 wire string.

calculated.description: For default properties, true when a HubSpot process calculates the value.

calculationFormula.description: Formula that computes a calculated property.

createdAt.description: When the property was created, as an ISO 8601 wire string.

createdUserId.description: HubSpot user id of the creator; absent when the property was created outside HubSpot.

currencyPropertyName.description: Name of the related currency property.

externalOptions.description: For default properties, true when the options are stored outside the property settings.

formField.description: Whether the property can be used in a HubSpot form.

hasUniqueValue.description: Whether the property value must be unique.

hidden.description: Whether the property is hidden from the HubSpot UI.

hubspotDefined.description: True for default properties built into HubSpot.

modificationMetadata.description: Edit permissions on the property; may be absent.

archivable.description: Whether the property can be archived.

readOnlyDefinition.description: Whether the property definition is read-only.

readOnlyValue.description: Whether the property value is read-only.

readOnlyOptions.description: Whether the property options are read-only.

numberDisplayHint.description: How number values are displayed and validated.

referencedObjectType.description: Object type the property refers to, when it relates to other objects.

sensitiveDataCategories.description: Categories of sensitive data the property holds.

showCurrencySymbol.description: Whether the account currency symbol is displayed with the value.

textDisplayHint.description: How text values are displayed and validated.

updatedAt.description: When the property was last updated, as an ISO 8601 wire string.

updatedUserId.description: HubSpot user id of the last editor; absent when the property was updated outside HubSpot.
